title: Anirudh
desc: A wealthy businessman's promise to get his son married to his brother-in-law's daughter is disrupted when he learns that his son is in love with someone else.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.

title: Cadaver
desc: When two surgeons mysteriously get murdered by Vetri, a prisoner, the responsibility of locating his accomplice falls on the shoulders of a pathologist.

title: Ivan Sariyanavan
desc: An ex- army vigilante fights against corruption. However, he finds himself in a dilemma when his lover promises to marry him only if he gives up his violent ways.

title: Maari
desc: Maari, a criminal, constantly troubles the people in his locality and extorts money from them. But his life changes when Sridevi, a pretty woman, falls in love with him.

title: Tej I Love You
desc: Tej, a young man, gets banished from his family for breaking his sister's marriage. He moves to London where he falls in love with a beautiful girl, Nandini.

title: Pugaipadam
desc: A group of college friends welcome Shiny into their circle. Soon, Krishna from the group and Shiny fall in love with each other but decide to keep it a secret.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Yakhshee
desc: An unknown spirit protects a woman from possible threats. However, when the woman falls in love with a man, the spirit is not too happy about it.

title: Vishwaroopam 2
desc: Wisam Ahmad Kashmiri, a RAW agent, tries to prevent a terrorist organisation from executing a deadly mission against three countries.

title: Kannula Thimiru
desc: After witnessing the execution of his parents, an orphan grows up to become a vicious man. To avenge their deaths, he holds 300 people captive and threatens the police.

title: Aamaa
desc: A series of ominous events unfurl when a newly married couple move into a house haunted by a voyeuristic spirit that soon becomes fixated on the wife.

title: Frienda Pola Yaaru Machaan
desc: Abhi crosses paths with his long-lost friend, Vasu. Soon, as they reconnect and reminisce old times, their ugly past is revealed.

title: Shivan
desc: A man and a woman are in love with each other but on the day of their wedding, he ends up killing her. Soon, in prison, he realises the conspiracy behind the crime and plans to solve the mystery.

title: Pailwaan
desc: A coach on the hunt for a new fighter finds Krishna, an orphan mentored by Sarkar. Krishna evolves into Kichcha, making a name for himself in the boxing ring.
